How the job runs

Every job follows the same sequence, whether it's a driveway or a car park.

Site Assessment & Quote

We look at the site, check drainage and access, and give you a straight quote — no surprises once the trucks turn up.

Excavation & Base Prep

Old surface removed if needed, ground levelled, and a solid base laid so the finished job actually lasts.

Compaction

Base and binder courses compacted properly — this is the step that gets skipped by cheap jobs and shows up as cracking within a year.

Asphalt Laying

Hot mix laid and rolled to a smooth, even finish with correct falls for drainage.

Finishing & Line Marking

Edges cleaned up, site cleared, and line marking applied where the job calls for it — in and out.

About Us

In & Out Asphalting was founded in South Sydney by a group of close friends and family who wanted to do this properly — no shortcuts, no half-finished driveways, no subcontractors who disappear halfway through a job.

Between us, we've got 6+ years running asphalt jobs across Sydney, and the operators on our machines carry 10+ years of hands-on experience each. Where we bring in outside help, it's local, family-owned businesses we've worked with directly and who've proven their due diligence on site — not whoever was cheapest that week.
